method: Recursively read archive members, verify ZIP CRC, scan text and binary bytes for credential patterns, extract PDF text, clone bundles locally and scan every stored blob/commit/tag plus every historical tree path. SHA deduplication links repeated identical bytes. No matched values are emitted. No network or sealed-source mutations. No proof rerun.
qualification: Bounded automated pattern/path review with candidate adjudication and exact accepted-archive hash binding. This is evidence that no listed credential patterns or sensitive account-file paths were found, not a proof that arbitrary hidden secrets are impossible. No mathematical proof was rerun and no sealed bytes changed.

manual_adjudication.email_findings: All matched mailboxes occur as .invalid placeholder Git author/config identities or the public npm glob maintainer contact in dependency warning logs; no personal user mailbox found. Values intentionally omitted.
manual_adjudication.local_identity_visibility: Saved proof evidence includes the already-used local username in absolute paths and temporary Colab VM/boot/session identifiers. These are expected provenance metadata, not authentication credentials.
manual_adjudication.connection_context_findings: Context flags are proof/recovery reports, source tools, archived command histories and inventories containing words colab plus proxy/endpoint. Credential patterns found no literal token/password/private-key payload. No credential/account configuration file appears in member/history paths.
manual_adjudication.pdfs: Four known one-page Exp006–009 scientific convergence PDFs, each20–28KB. All text and metadata parsed with pypdf6.18.0; no PDF attachment payloads appeared.
manual_adjudication.binary_payloads: Remaining seven distinct binary-classified payloads are three NUL-delimited Git file/diff logs and four PNG counterparts of scientific convergence plots. Raw bytes scanned; no raster OCR or steganography analysis claimed.
manual_adjudication.size: Largest outer asset39,096,085bytes; largest nested nonarchive leaf15,712,598bytes is SAVED_FILES.jsonl. No embedded compiler, .lake, node_modules, Python virtualenv or dependency-cache directories found; evidence includes cache/hash manifests as text.
manual_adjudication.history: Eleven distinct bundle byte streams were cloned into temporary local bare repositories and passed git fsck --full --strict. Every stored blob/commit/tag and historical tree path was inspected; identical byte payloads were deduplicated by SHA256.
manual_adjudication.recommendation: Publish the exact selected verified bytes under the authorization already given, preserving hash companions and completed-versus-WIP labels. No sanitization of sealed archives is indicated by the review.
